name: get_webpage_title
description: Fetch a webpage and return the content of its <title> tag.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch (e.g. https://www.example.com)

title.description: The page's <title>, which is the site's own claim about the page rather than a verified description.

name: get_webpage_text_from_url
description: Render a URL as PDF and extract its text (JavaScript supported).

url.description: Webpage URL to fetch and render

return_schema.description: What the caller receives. The key holding the text is `fields.return_key` from this tool's own config, which is `text`.

oneOf.description: The page was fetched and its text extracted. The only key is the one named by fields.return_key.

text.description: The extracted text, stripped. Empty when the page carried no text.

oneOf.description: The fetch or the render failed: a missing or non-http(s) url, a timeout, a non-200 status, a response that is not HTML, or no renderer installed. Measured in an environment without one: {'status': 'error', 'error': "rendering this page needs a browser. Install with: pip install 'tooluniverse[browser]' ..."}.
